subtitle: Cozy hot springs for monkeys
description:
Simmerstone is a cozy tending game about a snowy hillside of hot spring pools. Snow monkeys in knitted hats wander down the path to soak. Tap a pool to drop a glowing ember stone in and warm it, and keep every pool at the warmth its bathers want. Content monkeys close their eyes, sigh and send up little hearts of steam.

The twist is that warmer is not always better. Each monkey's hat shows what it likes: blue for mild, green for warm, red for hot. Let a pool go cold and they shiver; overdo it and the water boils and everyone hops out onto the rocks. You are keeping a spread of just-right pools for whoever comes down the path next.

The pools sit on terraces, and hot water runs downhill. Every stone also spills a little heat into the two pools below it, so the top pool steers the whole hill. Your basket only holds a few hot stones at a time, so you choose where each one goes.

As dusk goes on, more monkeys arrive, new pools open up and snow flurries roll through. Three unhappy monkeys and the hill goes quiet, but a long run of happy soaks earns a mandarin that wins a mitten back. Chase your best score.

Every hat also has its own bobble count, so you can play without telling colours apart. Plays offline. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.
promo: Warm the pools, match each snow monkey's hat and keep the steam rising. A calm, cozy tending game on a snowy hill at dusk.
reviewNote: Tap to start. Tap a pool to drop a hot stone in and warm it; each monkey's hat colour and bobble count show the warmth it wants, so keep pools in the right band and the monkeys soak happily. The game ends after 3 monkeys leave unhappy.
